Highlights

Highlights

Deliciously Detailed

Sculpted polished chrome bezels and stainless steel knobs bring new clarity and cohesion to the Viking 5 Series Range, refining its presence while honoring its iconic heritage.

TruPower Plus™ 18,500 BTU Burner

The TruPower Plus™ front burner on select Custom Series rangetops lets you cook like a pro with 18,500 BTUs of professional power.

Porcelainized Cooking Surface

Keep spills in one place with the raised edges of our exclusive one-piece tooled porcelainized cooking surface. Raised edges around perimeter seal top to completely contain spills. Porcelanized for easy cleaning, durability and long lasting finish.

VariSimmer™ Setting

The VariSimmer™ Setting on ALL burners provides gentle, even simmering at precisely low cooking temperatures.

SureSpark™ Ignition System

The exclusive SureSpark™ Ignition System ensures automatic ignition/re-ignition should the burners extinguish any time while cooking.

VSH™ Pro Sealed Burner System

Cook like a pro with up to 18,500 BTUs and infinite settings of easy-to-clean high performance sealed burners. Combination of unique patented burner and surface design provides cleanability plus superior performance at any temperature setting.
